decisions.reason: Relocating the panel power-button connector does not change DCDC1 voltage regulation or compensation.
The source does not change standalone USB power activation, regulation, loads, or source selection.
The panel power-button connection is independent of the battery charge-status LED and connector requirements.
The source does not alter the battery connector, its accessibility, or its pin functions.
Tapping PWRON for a panel button does not change the software-switched 5V rail or its enable control.
The source does not change battery cutoff, thermal sensing, or other safety-protection behavior.
The panel-button relocation does not affect current monitoring of the 3.3V or 5V rails.
The AXP2101 remains the normal-operation power-management IC; only the location of the connector accessing its PWRON signal changes.
The source does not change ESP32 sleep policies, wake sources, or wake timing.
The new button connector taps a signal line and does not alter interboard power connectors, pinouts, or distribution.
The source confirms the existing PWRON assignment on J_PWR_SIG pin 4 and does not change the interboard signal connector or pinout.
The panel reset input remains a separate EN-to-GND control and is unaffected by adding a PWRON power-button connector.
